basic_info.description: Welcome to 444 Ellington Avenue, a charming single-family home nestled in San Franciscos vibrant Outer Mission neighborhood. This classic 1927 residence offers timeless appeal with tremendous potential. Boasting approximately 1,275 sqft of living space on a 2,495 sqft lot, the home features a flexible layout with six rooms including a bright living room, formal dining area, two spacious bedrooms, one full bathroom + bonus second bath.  The kitchen is ready for your personal touch or full renovation. A one-car garage and additional storage space add convenience. Located just minutes from public transportation, freeways, schools, parks, and shopping, 444 Ellington offers an excellent opportunity to own in one of the city's most accessible and evolving neighborhoods. Whether you're a first-time buyer, investor, or someone looking to restore and customize, this home is filled with promise and possibility. Don't miss your chance to make it your own!
